subject: Hosted API renewal: request to increase monthly commit + tier migration
messages:
From: Emma Li <emma.li@arteklabs.com>
To: diego_fernandez@redwood.ai
Cc: Procurement <procurement@arteklabs.com>
Date: 2026-10-01T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Hosted API renewal & commit increase request

Hi Diego,

Hope you're well — quick note from Artek as we look at next year's plans. Our usage has consistently outpaced the 3M token/month commit we signed earlier this year; Q3 ended ~2.6x that baseline (report attached). We're planning to increase our customer-facing features that hit generation-heavy flows and want to lock in a larger monthly commit and smoother rate tiers to avoid frequent soft-throttles.

High-level asks:
- Increase committed monthly tokens to 7M (with staged ramp over 3 months).
- Lower per-token rate on the 4M+ band and add a small burst bucket for spikes.
- Keep latency SLOs at current levels; we may request regional routing to west/us-west.

Can you share a runbook for onboarding a higher commit and a draft SOW+pricing? We'd like to review internally and then kick off procurement.

Thanks — attaching the Q3 usage CSV.

Best,
Emma Li
Head of Platform Ops, Artek Labs
attachments: artek_q3_hosted_usage.csv (csv)

From: diego_fernandez@redwood.ai
To: Emma Li <emma.li@arteklabs.com>
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-10-02T10:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Hosted API renewal & commit increase request

Emma — thanks for the context and the usage file. This aligns with what we saw on our end. I'd be happy to get a proposal over this week.

Quick responses to your asks: 
- We can provision a staged commit increase to 7M tokens/month with a 3-month ramp (month 1: 4.5M, month 2: 6M, month 3: 7M) and an optional burst bucket you can draw from for unexpected spikes.
- We can add a rebalanced rate band for consumption >4M to provide a lower unit price; I'll include both a conservative and an aggressive pricing ladder in the SOW so your finance team can pick.
- Regional routing to us-west is possible; we recommend a hybrid fallback to our global pool for failover so SLA coverage stays consistent.

Next steps I propose:
1) I attach a short renewal_summary_v1.pdf that outlines the commit schedule, proposed rate bands, and an ops checklist for onboarding.
2) If that looks good, we'll issue a redwood_sow_ark_v2.docx for signature (DocuSign link).
3) We'll schedule a 30-minute ops handoff with our capacity team to lock in autoscale thresholds and KV cache sizing.

If procurement needs specific contract language (invoicing cadence, PO flow), loop them in and I'll copy Laura from legal to review.

Can we target signing by Oct 8 so we can schedule provisioning before your November launch?

Thanks,
Diego Fernandez
Account Lead — Enterprise, Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference
attachments: renewal_summary_v1.pdf (pdf)

From: diego_fernandez@redwood.ai
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai, lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-10-03T08:30:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Artek renewal — pricing & ops notes (need quick alignment)

Team — forwarding Emma's note and my reply. Key asks from Artek: staged commit to 7M, banded discounts above 4M, and a burst pocket. Fast timeline: they want us to sign by Oct 8 and provision before their Nov feature launch.

Operational considerations:
- Capacity: west/us-west regional preference. Vanessa, can we reserve a slice on the west pool for staged ramp? If not, what's lead time for dedicated soft-reserve?
- Rate bands: Ben, can you confirm margin at the proposed aggressive ladder (I included two ladders in the summary PDF). We should keep an option to set a soft cap for month 1 so we can limit exposure during ramp.
- Contract: Lauren, procurement will likely ask for net-45 invoicing and a clause for one-time onboarding credits. Can you review the SOW document once I produce it?

I'll push the SOW today; want to keep the external thread concise. If we can commit to a west slice and confirm pricing bands, I'll include the DocuSign link in my next note.

Thanks — Diego
(Internal)
attachments: redwood_sow_ark_v2.docx (draft)

From: diego_fernandez@redwood.ai
To: Emma Li <emma.li@arteklabs.com>, Procurement <procurement@arteklabs.com>, Marcus Reed <marcus.reed@marcus.reed@marcus.reed@marcus.reed@arteklabs.com>

Date: 2026-10-04T16:02:00-07:00
Subject: Hosted API renewal & SOW link — Artek Labs (staged 7M commit)

Emma / Artek team — thanks for the quick turnaround. Attached is the SOW draft (redwood_sow_ark_v2.docx) and a short summary PDF with two pricing ladders. TL;DR of the proposal:
- Staged monthly commit ramp: Month 1 = 4.5M, Month 2 = 6M, Month 3 = 7M tokens
- Burst pocket: 500k tokens/month available at the same band rate for emergency spikes (one-time overage trigger)
- Rate bands: conservative ladder and aggressive ladder attached; aggressive ladder reduces per-token cost by ~18% above 4M.
- Regional slice: we've reserved a soft slice in us-west for your ramp window and will prioritize your queues during the first 60 days.

For procurement: DocuSign link to a clean SOW + order form: https://www.docusign.com/Envelope/XYZ-ARK-2026
HubSpot deal record: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/987654321/ARK-2026-00123
Drive folder with onboarding plan: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2b3C-artek-renewal

Ask: please review the attached SOW and sign the DocuSign envelope by Oct 8 if acceptable. If procurement needs net-45 instead of net-30, confirm here and I'll flag to Finance and Legal for approval.

Forwarding the onboarding checklist: once signed we'll schedule the 30-min capacity and KV-cache session (Ops + Artek platform) and set the ramp start date.
